profile.description: Offline-first evidence and verification framework for AI model artifacts, transformations, runtime identity, and provenance.

PRIVATE_VULNERABILITY_REPORTING.reason: Reviewed official GitHub documentation limits Private Vulnerability Reporting to public repositories, so R1E must not attempt enablement while the repository remains private.
PRIVATE_VULNERABILITY_REPORTING.observation_limitation: The HTTP 404 remains API-ambiguous and does not itself prove public-only eligibility; that constraint comes from reviewed official GitHub documentation for public repositories.
PRIVATE_VULNERABILITY_REPORTING.verification_method: Only after separately authorized PUBLIC visibility, require a 204 PUT response and then a 200 GET whose enabled field is true.
PRIVATE_VULNERABILITY_REPORTING.failure_behavior: Classify PUBLIC_VISIBILITY_CHANGED_REQUIRED_PUBLIC_CONTROL_FAILED, stop publication, and prohibit announcement, tag, release, and PyPI operations.

SECRET_SCANNING.reason: Secret scanning was enabled during the controlled public attempt, but its public-only state became unavailable to the repository API after the authorized rollback to private.
SECRET_SCANNING.observation_source: After the repository returned to PRIVATE, authenticated repository security-and-analysis and secret-scanning reads no longer exposed a classifiable enabled or disabled state.
SECRET_SCANNING.observation_limitation: API_STATE_UNAVAILABLE while private is neither enabled nor disabled and does not establish the state that a future public transaction will read back.
SECRET_SCANNING.verification_method: After visibility changes, PATCH security_and_analysis.secret_scanning to enabled and re-read the repository security_and_analysis state.
SECRET_SCANNING.failure_behavior: Stop before tag, release, or PyPI operations; report the unapplied control without weakening the policy.

PUSH_PROTECTION.reason: Push protection was enabled during the controlled public attempt, but its public-only state became unavailable to the repository API after the authorized rollback to private.
PUSH_PROTECTION.observation_source: After the repository returned to PRIVATE, authenticated repository security-and-analysis reads no longer exposed a classifiable push-protection state.
PUSH_PROTECTION.observation_limitation: API_STATE_UNAVAILABLE while private is neither enabled nor disabled and cannot be used as proof of a future public state.
PUSH_PROTECTION.verification_method: After visibility changes, PATCH secret_scanning_push_protection to enabled and re-read the repository security_and_analysis state.
PUSH_PROTECTION.failure_behavior: Stop before tag, release, or PyPI operations and retain API_STATE_UNAVAILABLE until a future public read-back succeeds.

DEPENDABOT_ALERTS.reason: The R1E private release enabled Dependabot alerts after green CI and immediately verified the official status endpoint.
DEPENDABOT_ALERTS.observation_source: GET /repos/200lz/open-model-integration-validator/vulnerability-alerts returned HTTP 204 after the authorized R1E PUT returned HTTP 204.
DEPENDABOT_ALERTS.observation_limitation: This reports only repository vulnerability-alert enablement, not the absence of vulnerabilities.
DEPENDABOT_ALERTS.verification_method: Require the status GET to return HTTP 204 before and after any future visibility transaction.
DEPENDABOT_ALERTS.failure_behavior: Stop before visibility change if the verified enabled state is lost or cannot be read back.

DEPENDABOT_SECURITY_UPDATES.reason: The R1E private release enabled automated security updates after Dependabot alerts and immediately verified the official state endpoint.
DEPENDABOT_SECURITY_UPDATES.observation_source: GET /repos/200lz/open-model-integration-validator/automated-security-fixes returned HTTP 200 with enabled true and paused false after the authorized R1E PUT returned HTTP 204.
DEPENDABOT_SECURITY_UPDATES.observation_limitation: This reports the automated security-update switch, not whether a future update will be safe to merge.
DEPENDABOT_SECURITY_UPDATES.verification_method: Require a 200 GET whose enabled field remains true before and after any future visibility transaction.
DEPENDABOT_SECURITY_UPDATES.failure_behavior: Stop before visibility change if the verified enabled state is lost or cannot be read back.

CODE_SCANNING.reason: No CodeQL workflow exists; R1F records an explicit decision to defer CodeQL to a separate reviewed post-public change rather than adding an unvalidated launch workflow.
CODE_SCANNING.observation_source: GET /repos/200lz/open-model-integration-validator/code-scanning/alerts returned HTTP 403 stating code scanning is not enabled, and no tracked CodeQL workflow exists.
CODE_SCANNING.observation_limitation: The alert endpoint cannot establish suitability of a future CodeQL configuration.
CODE_SCANNING.verification_method: A later protected public pull request must separately review languages, queries, triggers, permissions, runner isolation, and result handling before adding CodeQL.
CODE_SCANNING.failure_behavior: Keep the control deferred; do not claim enabled coverage or add an unreviewed workflow.

BRANCH_PROTECTION.reason: The authenticated endpoint explicitly requires a plan upgrade or public visibility.
BRANCH_PROTECTION.observation_source: GET /repos/200lz/open-model-integration-validator/branches/main/protection returned HTTP 403 requiring GitHub Pro or public visibility.
BRANCH_PROTECTION.observation_limitation: The private-plan response does not establish which protection features will be available after publication.
BRANCH_PROTECTION.verification_method: Immediately after visibility changes, apply the reviewed main-branch protection payload and re-read every returned protection field.
BRANCH_PROTECTION.failure_behavior: Stop before tag, release, or PyPI operations; do not substitute an unverified weaker rule.

REPOSITORY_RULESETS.reason: The authenticated endpoint explicitly requires a plan upgrade or public visibility, and R1F selects branch protection as the sole initial main-enforcement mechanism.
REPOSITORY_RULESETS.observation_source: GET /repos/200lz/open-model-integration-validator/rulesets returned HTTP 403 requiring GitHub Pro or public visibility.
REPOSITORY_RULESETS.observation_limitation: The response establishes current unavailability but not post-public ruleset capabilities.
REPOSITORY_RULESETS.verification_method: Verify no overlapping ruleset is configured when the reviewed branch-protection payload is applied and read back.
REPOSITORY_RULESETS.failure_behavior: Stop if an overlapping or contradictory ruleset appears; do not configure both mechanisms implicitly.

ACTIONS_DEFAULT_PERMISSIONS.reason: The repository default token permission is read and workflows cannot approve pull-request reviews.
ACTIONS_DEFAULT_PERMISSIONS.observation_source: GET /actions/permissions/workflow returned read default permissions and can_approve_pull_request_reviews false.
ACTIONS_DEFAULT_PERMISSIONS.observation_limitation: Repository defaults do not replace inspection of explicit permissions in each tracked workflow.
ACTIONS_DEFAULT_PERMISSIONS.verification_method: Re-read the repository setting and statically verify every workflow before and after publication.
ACTIONS_DEFAULT_PERMISSIONS.failure_behavior: Stop if permissions become writable or workflow approval becomes enabled.

ACTION_PINNING.reason: Every official Action in the tracked workflow is pinned to a full commit SHA.
ACTION_PINNING.observation_source: Static inspection of .github/workflows/ci.yml found two official Actions pinned to full 40-character commit SHAs.
ACTION_PINNING.observation_limitation: A SHA pin establishes immutability of the selected revision, not trustworthiness of Action behavior.
ACTION_PINNING.verification_method: Run the offline workflow audit and review every Dependabot Action update before merge.
ACTION_PINNING.failure_behavior: Fail CI and prohibit merge while any Action reference is mutable or unexpected.

FORCE_PUSH_PROTECTION.reason: This is enforced through the unavailable branch protection or ruleset control.
FORCE_PUSH_PROTECTION.observation_source: The main branch protection and ruleset endpoints returned the current private-plan HTTP 403 limitation.
FORCE_PUSH_PROTECTION.observation_limitation: No independent force-push rule exists until one enforcement mechanism is available and configured.
FORCE_PUSH_PROTECTION.verification_method: After publication, re-read the selected enforcement mechanism and require allow_force_pushes false or the equivalent rule.
FORCE_PUSH_PROTECTION.failure_behavior: Stop before tag, release, or PyPI operations if force pushes are not denied.

BRANCH_DELETION_PROTECTION.reason: This is enforced through the unavailable branch protection or ruleset control.
BRANCH_DELETION_PROTECTION.observation_source: The main branch protection and ruleset endpoints returned the current private-plan HTTP 403 limitation.
BRANCH_DELETION_PROTECTION.observation_limitation: No independent deletion rule exists until one enforcement mechanism is available and configured.
BRANCH_DELETION_PROTECTION.verification_method: After publication, re-read the selected enforcement mechanism and require allow_deletions false or the equivalent rule.
BRANCH_DELETION_PROTECTION.failure_behavior: Stop before tag, release, or PyPI operations if branch deletion is not denied.

publication_incident.exposure_limitation: Returning PRIVATE cannot erase prior observation, indexing, links, caches, copies, stars, watchers, forks, or repository-network effects; no claim is made that no third party observed or copied the repository.

final_public_state.description: Offline-first evidence and verification framework for AI model artifacts, transformations, runtime identity, and provenance.

main_enforcement.single_maintainer_reason: The sole maintainer cannot supply independent approval for their own change; zero approvals keeps pull requests and required CI enforceable without claiming external review.
main_enforcement.administrator_behavior: enforce_admins false leaves an emergency administrator bypass; it is not routine approval evidence and any use requires a public audit trail.
main_enforcement.read_back_requirement: Validate response representation independently: require strict true and all four exact checks with GitHub Actions App ID 15368; if GitHub returns derived contexts, require exactly the same four names but never treat contexts alone as App binding. Verify every other payload field and the absence of an overlapping ruleset. Re-verify the App identity on the exact future green private-main commit before application.

rollback_authority.risk_statement: Public observation may already have occurred; URLs or announcements may be shared or indexed; stars, watchers, forks, repository-network relationships, Actions visibility, Pages or package exposure, and security-control state may change; returning to private cannot erase prior exposure or make public links unseen.

codeql_decision.reason: Code scanning is unavailable under the current private plan, an unvalidated workflow is unsuitable for launch optics, and existing CI does not replace CodeQL.
codeql_decision.future_boundary: Use the protected public pull-request flow to review language coverage, queries, events, permissions, runners, and alert handling.

r1f_prerequisites: R1E is released to private main and its exact CI run succeeds.
The reviewed profile, topics, Actions permissions, and private Dependabot controls are independently re-read.
The R1F implementation is released to private main and its exact Python 3.11 through 3.14 CI is green.
The final private publication audit passes immediately before any visibility mutation.
Visibility change has separate explicit owner authorization.
Exactly one rollback-authority choice is explicitly selected by the owner before visibility changes.
stop_conditions: Repository identity, baseline, default branch, or visibility differs from the approved state.
Required private Dependabot controls are not enabled and verified before visibility changes.
Visibility authorization or the explicit rollback-authority decision is missing.
Required public-only controls cannot be enabled and verified immediately after visibility changes.
A workflow gains write permission, uses an unpinned Action, uses pull_request_target, or selects a self-hosted runner.
A secret, credential, private payload, local path, or sensitive API response is found.
The exact checks-only branch-protection payload or one of the four required app-bound checks cannot be applied and read back.
Any post-public verification differs from the approved policy.
The unauthenticated public-read smoke check fails.
Any tag, GitHub release, package, PyPI publication, or announcement is attempted within the visibility transaction.
